description: List articles of one language (German by default, language "en" for English) newest first, optionally filtered by tag or year, plus all tags of that language with their counts.

language.description: Language of the articles: "de" (German, the default) or "en" (English translations). Every article exists in both.

limit.description: Maximum number of results (search: 8, list: 50 by default).

name: list_articles
